scripts.stack:up: STACK_RELEASE=$(git rev-parse HEAD) docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.stack.yml up --build --detach --wait
scripts.stack:verify: STACK_RELEASE=$(git rev-parse HEAD) docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.stack.yml run --build --rm verify
scripts.stack:down: STACK_RELEASE=unused docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.stack.yml rm --stop --force stack-database migrate api worker edge verify
scripts.sourcemaps:upload: sentry-cli sourcemaps inject "$SOURCEMAPS_DIR" && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --release "$APP_RELEASE" "$SOURCEMAPS_DIR"
